name: saasquatch-signal
description: SaaSquatch Signal — Explainable Lead Intelligence & Prioritization Layer

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); console.log('Starting SaaSquatch Signal Server & Client...'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
